title: Circuit-boundary tuning and adaptive probe experiments for automatic fallback
creator: Asha Patel
description: Implement, tune, and validate an adaptive automatic fallback system that combines 429/timeouts/error-rate signals into a trip score, applies tenant- and region-aware circuit boundaries, and uses controlled probe/rehabilitation traffic to restore traffic when safe. This work covers signal definition, trip scoring, probation probes, staged rollout, and dashboards/alerts needed for ops. Goal is to reduce false-positive fallbacks while limiting customer disruption and maintaining SLOs.
acceptance_criteria: Signal fusion implementation that ingests per-tenant + per-region metrics (429 rate, avg latency, p95/p99, timeout count, model error rate) into a normalized trip score
Configurable circuit boundary rules: tenant sensitivity, region multipliers, tier (hosted/dedicated/private) overrides
Probation probe mechanism that sends low-volume canary requests to candidate fallback variant and validates quality + latency before full traffic cutover
Cooldown and decaying trip score to prevent oscillation; documented hysteresis parameters
Automated experiment harness + dashboards showing trip score, probe outcomes, rollback events, and user-visible error trends
Runbook for oncall with actions and rollback steps; successful simulated incident run without operator intervention in staging
tasks: Define normalized signal schema and scoring function (SRE + Runtime) - Asha/Marco
Implement signal aggregation pipeline (per-tenant, per-region, per-model-variant) - Runtime team
Add tenant-aware sensitivity config and region multipliers - Runtime/Config service
Implement probation probe runner and result evaluator (quality + latency thresholds) - Serving runtime
Add circuit state machine with cooldown, decay, and manual override APIs - Router service
Instrumentation and dashboards: trip_score_timeseries, probe_success_rate, fallback_count_by_region/tenant - Observability
Create canary rollout plan and automated experiments for false-positive/negative validation - Product/Experiments
End-to-end integration tests and staging fault injection scenarios - QA
comments: 2026-03-01 - Asha Patel: Kickoff notes: agreed scope includes both region selection multipliers and tenant sensitivity. Priority P0 due to customer incidents last week. Need short proposal for scoring function by 2026-03-05.

2026-03-04 - Marco Nguyen: Uploaded initial scoring sketch: weighted sum of normalized 429 rate, timeout rate, and error-rate with exponential decay. Shared with SRE; feedback: incorporate request rate normalization to avoid noisy scores on low-volume tenants.
2026-03-06 - SRE (Lina Ramos): Review feedback: add a minimum-sample threshold and Bayesian shrinkage on rates. Also recommend per-region baseline adjustments for known noisy regions.

2026-03-08 - Marco Nguyen: Implemented prototype scorer in staging pipeline + added metric 'trip_score_v0' to observability. Running synthetic tests with injected 429 spikes. Initial results: 12% false positives on low-volume tenants; will add min-sample and shrinkage later this week.

2026-03-10 - Product PM (Eric Zhou): Please ensure probation probes validate semantic quality (not just latency). Suggest integrating small held-out prompt set and embedding-based similarity check for loss-of-quality detection.

2026-03-11 - Marco Nguyen: Added probe evaluator that calculates mean embedding similarity against golden responses and enforces both latency and quality thresholds. Probe runner currently supports sampling 0.1% of traffic during probation. Need to tune thresholds via A/B experiments in staging.

2026-03-12 - Asha Patel: Plan for staged rollout: 1) internal-only in staging with fault injection, 2) shadow routing for 5% of traffic for 48 hours, 3) enable soft-fallback (traffic split 20/80) for selected tenants, 4) full enable for low-risk tenants. Create runbook and add alerts for probe-failures and oscillation loops.
